The following controls from [Input Validation](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/4.0/en/0x13-V5-Input-Validation.md) should probably have some hint of how to do this.... 

| # | Description | L1 | L2 | L3 | Since |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | -- | -- |
| 5.3.7 | Verify that the application protects against SMTP or IMAP injection. | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | 4.0 |
| 5.3.8 | Verify that the application protects against eval(), template injection, or remote code execution attacks. | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | 4.0 |
title: Input Validation requirements without actions
